title: Updates & doctor
description: Stay current with template releases and verify local setup.

blocks.text: Your .tempjs.json stores templateVersion and a hash baseline. When maintainers publish a new template version, use update commands inside the client project.

blocks.title: Protected files
blocks.text: Merge never overwrites .env, constants/site.ts, .tempjsrc, or your brand customizations. Conflicts are listed for manual review.
Generated projects include CHANGELOG.md describing template releases. Read it after tempjs update --check shows a version gap.
